    <script type='text/javascript' nonce="xeCQhii9/WIYAsXUV4fyM5VmkIkcC53cHRqjwWbj2/c=">
            try {
                var redirectURL = 'https://admin.cloud.microsoft';
                var hashPage = window.location.hash.substring(1);
                var queryString = '?ref=%2Fhomepage';
                var ignoreHashHandling = 'True';

                if (queryString && queryString.length > 0) {
                    redirectURL = redirectURL + queryString;
                }
                if (ignoreHashHandling == 'False' && hashPage.length > 0) {
                    var refPart = queryString.length > 0 ? "&" : "?";
                    refPart = refPart + "ref=" + hashPage;
                    redirectURL = redirectURL + refPart;
                }

                performance.mark('@ms/mac/IB_CHPR_OCDI_Redirect');

                const mark = performance.getEntriesByName('@ms/mac/IB_CHPR_OCDI_Redirect')[0];
                if (mark) {
                    sessionStorage.setItem('@ms/mac/IB_CHPR_OCDI_Redirect', mark.startTime.toString());
                }

                window.location.href = redirectURL;
            }
            catch (err) {
                window.location.href = 'https://admin.cloud.microsoft';
            }
</script>
